messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-api-prod — condition=p99_latency > 3.0s for 5m. Paging #eng-oncall (pd.inc/ZX90Q).

sanjay: ack — grabbing tail logs and metrics now.

alex: seeing a sharp tail around 1758002000 UTC. p95 jumped from ~140ms -> ~700ms; p99 ~3.8s.

fiona: gpupool-west-3 hosts show concurrent KV cache evictions + an influx of long-context requests. Might be a replay or a batch job hitting prod routes.

sanjay: quick query I ran: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))` — gpupool-west-3 is the outlier.

alex: logs contain repeated requests with context_len>10k tokens and model=large-unfused. Looks like a customer eval replaying old traces.

fiona: proposal: divert non-realtime traffic away from large-unfused to fallback small-quant-2 and enable short-circuit for >8k contexts. Also reduce batcher wait on affected pool.

sanjay: implementing two fast mitigations now:
```
rdw infra batcher update --pool gpupool-west-3 --window-ms 8
rdw routing add-rule --service inference-api-prod --match 'route!=realtime' --target small-quant-2 --percent 25
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by sanjay at 1758002521.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: no L2 ack within 4m, auto-escalation scheduled.

alex: also patched batcher-sidecar on two pods to drop max-batch-size from 64 -> 16 to limit tail token batches (kubectl patch...).

maya: noted. If fallback reduces pressure we should do a controlled KV warmup for the top keys after traffic stabilizes.

fiona: initial impact observed — 6 minutes after routing change: p95 down to ~320ms, p99 down to ~1.4s. Error rate stable. Good sign.

sanjay: still seeing a small tail from the long-context replay. Applying APIGW rate limit for requests with context_len>8000: 5r/min.

alex: queue depth on gpupool-west-3 decreasing; spun up +1 pod to help drain backlog (autoscale override for 10m).

incident-bot: automated-check: latency trend decreasing; backlog metrics trending down — dashboard: grafana/inf-prod-tail.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: L2 (l2-oncall) acknowledged at 1758002872.

maya: taking handoff — will monitor for 30m, keeping routing fallback active and performing KV warmup for top hotkeys over 8m window (throttled).

fiona: adding follow-up note: suspected customer eval with replay and insufficient rate limits. Recommend CS outreach and temporary throttle on that customer job.

sanjay: created ticket INF-4829 "suspected replay causing p99 tail on gpupool-west-3". Assigning cs-team and infra-ops.

maya: if p99 exceeds 2.0s again escalate to platform@redwood and consider rolling rollback of large-unfused to a quantized variant.

alex: thanks all. Closing the active page flow for now, will collect traces and write a short postmortem in #postmortems once root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident RESOLVED at 1758003868.
